message: 腕力だけが力じゃない

name: Paqy
message: 「Nom-nom! Munch-munch!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't chew your food properly, you won't grow big and strong.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Phew--thanks for the grub!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're very welcome.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, sorry for making you do everything. As the Demon Lord's familiar, I'm totally pathetic.」

name: Synn
message: 「For someone saying that, I don't sense any intention to actually help out.」

name: Paqy
message: 「When it comes to spirit, I won't lose to anyone! Just spare me the humidity, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「This is why plushies are...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if I'm a plushie, I'm still the Demon Lord's familiar, ya know!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Demon Lord, Demon Lord. A Demon Lord, huh~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. What even is a Demon Lord in the first place?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Where does the Demon Lord come from, and where is he going? Getting awfully philosophical, aren't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「Demons flood into the Human World by taking advantage of Re-Crea. Normally, you'd picture the Demon Lord leading those demons to invade the Human World, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, wouldn't be weird if there were Demon Lords like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Honestly, for me, enjoying a bright, sparkling school life is way better than doing something like that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you conquer the Human World, it might sparkle even brighter, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I did that, it'd be glaring, not sparkling...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... A glaring paradise.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, just because I'm the Demon Lord doesn't mean I have the power to rule the Human World.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Power, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. The kind of power that wrecks buildings left and right or sends tons of people flying. Meanwhile, lifting three beer crates is already all I can handle.」

name: Synn
message: 「At the end of the day, that's the Demon Lord's limit. If I went up against an Eauderourke, I don't think I could even win one-on-one.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sixty beer bottles' worth. If you recycle 'em at five yen a bottle, that comes out to roughly three hundred yen's worth of power.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Now that you mention it, that might be a pretty big power.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, Demon Lord. Even without a power like that, you've got Eauderourke following you like a charm, don't ya?」

name: Synn
message: 「He's not following my orders or anything. He just became one of our friends, that's all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Seven Demon Generals are a bunch of born-and-bred egoists who do and eat whatever the hell they want, yet you can't get a handle on any of 'em, ya know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「And yet guys like that are happily listening to what you say and trying to be of help to others. Being able to make that happen is a talent in its own right.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if that talent is actually the power of the Demon Lord?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Nah, I've never heard of a power like that, probably.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~ Is it really okay for me to keep going like this~」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it ain't the power of the Demon Lord, then it's gotta be your own power--Synn-sama's power.」

name: Synn
message: 「But then, doesn't that mean I won't become the 'Demon Lord' you're looking for?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Who knows~? I wasn't expecting anything from you in the first place, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not having any expectations placed on me is pretty heartbreaking in its own way, you know.」
Even as they spoke, stars continued to fall endlessly across the sky.
